	city_graphics_type = ztr_jpk_city_early_modern
	priority = 2
	grid_size = { 5 3 }
	should_update_on_pm_change = yes

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			any_scope_state = {
				"b(building_power_plant)" ?= {
					OR = {
						is_under_construction = yes
						level > 0
					}
				}
			}
			any_scope_state = {
				"b(building_fusion_power_plant)" ?= {
					OR = {
						is_under_construction = yes
						level > 0
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	locator = { name = ztr_centre position = { 1.5 0 0 } rotation = { 0 0 0 } scale = 1.0 }
	locator = { name = ztr_thermal position = { -1.0 0 0 } rotation = { 0 0 0 } scale = 1.0 }
	composition_group = {
		composition = { name = ztr_fusion trigger = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_fusion_power_plant } } }
		composition = { name = ztr_nuclear trigger = { NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_fusion_power_plant } } any_scope_building = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant_2 has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant_3 } } } }
		composition = { name = ztr_coal trigger = { NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_fusion_power_plant } } any_scope_building = { has_active_production_method = pm_coal-fired_plant_3 } } }
		composition = { name = ztr_oil trigger = { NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_fusion_power_plant } } any_scope_building = { has_active_production_method = pm_oil-fired_plant_3 } } }
		composition = { name = ztr_gas trigger = { NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_fusion_power_plant } } any_scope_building = { has_active_production_method = pm_gas-fired_plant_3 } } }
		composition = { name = ztr_old trigger = {
			NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_fusion_power_plant } }
			any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_power_plant }
			NOT = { any_scope_building = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant_2 has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant_3 has_active_production_method = pm_coal-fired_plant_3 has_active_production_method = pm_oil-fired_plant_3 has_active_production_method = pm_gas-fired_plant_3 } } }
		} }
	}
	attach = { locator = ztr_centre variant = { entity = asian_city_centerpiece_01_entity } }
	attach = {
		locator = ztr_thermal
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_power_fusion_01_entity	building_type = building_fusion_power_plant	compositions = { ztr_fusion } }
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_power_nuclear_01_entity	building_type = building_power_plant	compositions = { ztr_nuclear } }
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_power_coal_01_entity	building_type = building_power_plant	compositions = { ztr_coal } }
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_power_oil_01_entity	building_type = building_power_plant	compositions = { ztr_oil } }
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_power_gas_01_entity	building_type = building_power_plant	compositions = { ztr_gas } }
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_power_vanilla_entity	building_type = building_power_plant	compositions = { ztr_old } }
	}
}

	grid_size = { 5 3 }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			"b(building_skyscraper)" ?= {
				OR = {
					is_under_construction = yes
					level > 0
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			any_scope_state = {
				"b(building_power_plant)" ?= {
					OR = {
						is_under_construction = yes
						level > 0
					}
				}
			}

						is_under_construction = yes

				}
			}

		composition = { name = ztr_gas trigger = { NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_fusion_power_plant } } any_scope_building = { has_active_production_method = pm_gas-fired_plant_3 } } }
		composition = { name = ztr_old trigger = {
			NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_fusion_power_plant } }
			any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_power_plant }
			NOT = { any_scope_building = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant_2 has_active_production_method = pm_nuclear-fission_plant_3 has_active_production_method = pm_coal-fired_plant_3 has_active_production_method = pm_oil-fired_plant_3 has_active_production_method = pm_gas-fired_plant_3 } } }
